description: The Ranger Lord's Behest Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen. Requirements: - Pathstrider x 8 - Ranger x 8 - Woodsman x 8 - Quel'Thalas Registry
name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
